name: Lastex yarn
summary: An elastic yarn with a rubber core wrapped in wool, rayon, silk or cotton thread; it let a knitted garment stretch and return.
how: Wrap a rubber thread in one or two layers of cotton, silk or rayon.
Knit or weave the yarn into a band or a panel.
Cut the band to length and finish the edge.

origin.note: The Adamson Brothers, part of the US Rubber Company, bring Lastex to the market.

adoptions.via: Makers of girdles and brassières used elastic yarn of rubber core to give the held waist of the new line.
